qt-avoid-qstring-allocations.title: Avoid unnecessary QString allocations
qt-avoid-qstring-allocations.summary: Prefer patterns that avoid temporary QString allocations in hot paths.
qt-avoid-qstring-allocations.why: Repeated implicit conversions and temporary allocations can add overhead; Qt provides APIs to reduce allocations (e.g., QStringView/QLatin1String where appropriate).
qt-avoid-qstring-allocations.exampleBefore: QString s = QString("prefix:") + value; // may allocate temporaries
notes: Exact advice depends on Qt version and the APIs available (Qt 6 has QStringView and more modern string handling).
Treat as a performance/style hint; validate with profiling for hot code.

qt-qstring-constref.title: Prefer QString passed by const reference (or view) where appropriate
qt-qstring-constref.summary: Avoid passing QString by value unless you intentionally want a copy/move.
qt-qstring-constref.why: Passing by value can cause copies or moves; for read-only parameters prefer const reference or a view type when compatible.
notes: In Qt 6 codebases, consider QStringView for APIs that don't need ownership.

modernize-use-nullptr.title: Use nullptr
modernize-use-nullptr.summary: Replace 0/NULL used as a null pointer with nullptr.
modernize-use-nullptr.why: nullptr is type-safe and avoids overload ambiguities.
notes: This is generally safe and widely adopted in C++11+ (including C++17).

modernize-use-override.title: Use override
modernize-use-override.summary: Mark overriding virtual functions with override.
modernize-use-override.why: Prevents subtle bugs from signature mismatches and improves readability.
modernize-use-override.exampleBefore:
struct Base { virtual void f(); };
struct D : Base { void f(); };
modernize-use-override.exampleAfter:
struct Base { virtual void f(); };
struct D : Base { void f() override; };
notes: Also consider using final on classes or methods where appropriate.

modernize-use-trailing-return-type.title: Use trailing return type
modernize-use-trailing-return-type.summary: Prefer a trailing return type for complicated return types or to match modern C++ style.
modernize-use-trailing-return-type.why: It can improve readability by moving the return type after the parameter list, especially when the return type is long, templated, or depends on parameters.
modernize-use-trailing-return-type.exampleBefore:
auto make() -> int; // already trailing

int f(const std::vector<int>& v) { return v.size(); }
modernize-use-trailing-return-type.exampleAfter: auto f(const std::vector<int>& v) -> int { return static_cast<int>(v.size()); }
notes: This rule is style-oriented; decide team-wide whether to enforce it.
If you want automatic changes, clang-tidy may be able to apply fixes depending on the project and compiler setup.
